policy: This file is NOT read by app/api/v1/spec, engines/validation/dispatcher.ts, or any runtime path. It exists solely to pin down the HTTP contract for planned MCP tools/resources before they are promoted into registry/command-registry.json or registry/mcp-resource-registry.json with status:active. No entry here is callable by any client.

registry.list_modules.note: registry.list_modules already exists as an active command in command-registry.json (owner: runtime/engine, output: string[]). MCP exposes the same capability under the same name via the existing GET /api/v1/modules route rather than creating a competing contract. No filter args in this first version because the existing command has none — any future filter must extend the existing command-registry entry, not diverge here.

registry.list_commands.note: Distinct from the existing GET /api/v1/spec, which returns OpenAI/Claude tool-schema-shaped output for external LLM tool-use and already filters deprecated/requires_confirmation:true commands. This endpoint returns the raw registry listing shape for MCP clients instead.

runtime.query.note: Pure passthrough. Confirmation-gating and Shadow Command rejection remain enforced entirely by the existing dispatcher — this tool adds no logic of its own.
runtime.query.integration_test_detail: Verified live: no-token -> CONFIGURATION_ERROR, invalid-token -> UNAUTHORIZED. NOT yet verified: successful read command, confirmation-required command rejection — both need a real DNA_OS_API_TOKEN, none was available in this environment. Status stays planned until both are confirmed, per the owner's Phase 1B lifecycle rule (active requires implementation AND integration test passed).

constitution.get_rules.note: GET /api/v1/constitution already exists (public, returns registry/CONSTITUTION.json verbatim). Reused instead of building a duplicate /api/v1/mcp/constitution route, per Rule 103.
